name: Gingerbread
summary: A soft molasses gingerbread, mixed with hot water and baked in a square tin.

equipment.help: Gingerbread burns at the edges before the middle sets if the heat is wrong for the oven.
equipment.label: Oven

steps.title: Grate the ginger
steps.body: Ground ginger is what the 1896 recipe calls for, but a little grated fresh ginger alongside it lifts the whole cake.

steps.title: Warm the molasses
steps.body: Heat the molasses and butter together until the butter melts. Do not let it boil.

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.body: Sift the flour, soda, ginger, cinnamon and salt together.

steps.title: Combine wet and dry
steps.body: Stir the sour milk and beaten egg into the warm molasses, then beat in the dry ingredients until smooth.
steps.note: The batter is thin, nearer a pancake batter than a cake batter. That is right.

steps.title: Butter the tin
steps.body: Butter an 8 inch square tin and line the bottom with paper.

steps.title: Heat a gas oven to 350°F
steps.body: Bake in the middle of a gas oven. The top heat will darken the crust quickly.

steps.title: Heat an electric oven to 350°F
steps.body: Wait for the preheat light. Gingerbread put into a cool oven sinks in the middle.

steps.title: Heat a convection oven to 325°F
steps.body: Drop the heat 25°F for the fan and start checking five minutes early.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake until a straw pushed into the middle comes out clean and the cake springs back.

steps.title: Cool in the tin
steps.body: Let it stand ten minutes before turning it out, or it will break across the middle.

steps.title: Cut and serve
steps.body: Cut in squares and serve warm, plain or with whipped cream.
